reflection: What is your honest reaction to the thought of three days without your phone? Write it down without judging it.
What counts as a genuine emergency for your responsibilities, in one sentence you could say to your contact?
How will you read Scripture and this course during the retreat? If the answer is 'on my phone', what will you do to make that workable?
What do you expect to be hardest on Day 1 without the phone, and what will you do when you reach for it?
